lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr2Zn2Pt6 (reduced formula SrZnPt3) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 10 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Pt centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 geometric neighbors (4 Pt, 4 Sr, 4 Zn), while Sr and Zn each have 16 neighbors (8 Pt, 4 Sr, 4 Zn) within 2.97–3.23 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 10 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Pt 12-vertex polyhedra, plus corner- and face-sharing between Pt and Sr 16-vertex polyhedra.
